goal: Run a symmetric JANUS threshold experiment in which the constructive P=NP lane and the obstruction P!=NP lane are both attacked by independent reverse replay before any promotion.

reverse_tranception_lane.operator: BACK -> FORWARD -> LEFT -> RIGHT -> FORWARD -> BACK
implementation_for_this_run: signed variable-coordinate reversal plus polarity inversion on GT12
exact Buzz inverse replay for every admitted absorption
C025 blocked-order obstruction attacked by interleaved-order reconstruction

mandatory_controls.C025_ABSORPTION: 2^n raw representations may collapse to one state only with polynomially checkable normalization certificates
mandatory_controls.C025_EQUALITY_ORDER: blocked exponential width must be attacked by interleaved order before any hardness promotion
mandatory_controls.C025_SEMANTIC_MERGE_BARRIER: unrestricted semantic equivalence is forbidden because F equivalent FALSE exactly when F is UNSAT
mandatory_controls.C024_FRACTURE_CONTROL: simple coarse topology is not a hardness or tractability certificate
mandatory_controls.APRIL18_NUMERIC_HORIZON: local objective PASS does not imply return-path health
mandatory_controls.MARCH_PHYSARUM_CONTRACT: compression parameters themselves must remain bounded

promotion_gates.P_EQUALS_NP: REQUIRES all-input deterministic polynomial construction/correctness/resource proof for an NP-complete language; finite GT12 can never satisfy this gate
promotion_gates.P_NOT_EQUALS_NP: REQUIRES a valid general lower-bound argument beyond the frozen residual architecture; finite state explosion or cap exhaustion can never satisfy this gate
promotion_gates.restricted_obstruction: MAY be reported only with architecture scope and after reverse order/decomposition attack
promotion_gates.finite_algorithmic_progress: MAY be reported with exact receipts and no asymptotic promotion

canonical_laws: LOCAL OBJECTIVE PASS != RETURN PATH HEALTHY
P_VS_NP = OPEN UNTIL A GENERAL PROOF PASSES
